content:
Jasper (Partner Ops): Big win — Osprey Connect signed a 3yr Dedicated commitment + ISV listing on DigitalOcean Marketplace, and they're kicking off a Private VPC pilot for regulated customers. Going public with marketing assets tomorrow. :tada:
Linh (Sales): Incredible — congrats team! Who owns the case study / customer quote?
Samira (Marketing): I can take the case study. Can we get a short quote and a 2-3 sentence customer profile? Preferably by EOD so we can hit tomorrow's newsletter.
Diego (Engineering): From infra side: I provisioned the dedicated GPU pool in prod-us-west2, pinned model to rwd-llama-7b-quant, and enabled Dedicated-first routing with Hosted fallback. KV cache warming scheduled for midnight.
Maria (Finance): Contract countersigned — 3 years, $1.1M ARR committed to reserved capacity. PO expected next week. Please add billing contact and SOW to the contract folder.
Jasper (Partner Ops): @Samira — Osprey legal ok'd a short quote: "Redwood scaled inference reliably across our sensitive workloads — the VPC option sealed it." They'll send brand assets + one-line CSM blurb in ~2 hours.
Samira (Marketing): Perfect. Also want a short video clip from their CTO — can someone on SEs coordinate? @Diego can you handle a 15-min tech interview?
Diego (Engineering): Yep. I'll set up a quick call with their CTO for tech questions and get a 1-2 min clip.
OpsBot: CRM update: Opportunity #OP-9981 marked as Closed-Won by Jasper. Partner stage -> Onboarding. Automatically created onboarding ticket: IN-4521.
MarketBot: Marketplace publish complete — Osprey Connect listing is live on DigitalOcean Marketplace: https://market.digitalocean.com/apps/osprey-connect-redwood (listing id: 0x8F4C). Indexing may take up to 30 mins.
Linh (Sales): Nice! Do we have a logo and 1-line summary for the marketplace card?
Jasper (Partner Ops): Logo and 1-line are in the shared drive: /partners/osprey_connect/brand.zip. Marketplace blurb: "Osprey Connect — secure, low-latency inference for regulated apps (Private VPC + Dedicated capacity)."
Samira (Marketing): Drafted announcement (internal + public) uploaded: https://redwood.workplace/docs/osprey-launch-draft.md. Please review the public copy and add any legal notes.
Maria (Finance): Heads-up: revenue recognition for reserved capacity will be recognized per contract schedule; billing contact: procurement@osprey.com.
Jasper (Partner Ops): Assigning follow-ups: @Samira — case study draft by Thu; @Diego — CTO clip by EOD tomorrow; @Maria — confirm PO and billing by next Mon. Thanks everyone, huge team effort. :rocket:
Linh (Sales): Adding a quick shoutout — huge congrats to @Jasper & @Linh-acctexec for closing. :clap:
MarketBot: Social preview generated: "Osprey Connect launches secure inference with Redwood — now available on DigitalOcean Marketplace." Suggestion: tag @OspreyTech in posts.
Samira (Marketing): I'll queue the social post for tomorrow 9am PT and coordinate a cross-post with their marketing team.
Diego (Engineering): Deploy checklist: 1) Warm KV cache 2) Run perf smoke 3) Enable canary routing 4) Monitor latency for first 2 hours. Posting status here after smoke run.
OpsBot: Onboarding ticket IN-4521 updated: initial SRE runbook attached.
Jasper (Partner Ops): Closing thread — will post final launch note after market indexing completes. Huge thanks team! :party_parrot:
